p2p_consent_body:
يستخدم هذا البث تقنية الند للند (P2P). بتفعيل P2P، أنت تقر وتوافق على الآتي:

• سيكون عنوان IP الخاص بك مرئياً للأقران الآخرين في الشبكة
• أنت وحدك المسؤول عن المحتوى الذي تصل إليه
• أنت تؤكد أن لديك الحق القانوني لبث هذا المحتوى في ولايتك القضائية
• لا تستضيف Nuvio أو توزع أو تتحكم في أي محتوى P2P
• لا تتحمل Nuvio أي مسؤولية عن أي عواقب قانونية تنشأ عن استخدامك لبث P2P

أنت تستخدم هذه الميزة على مسؤوليتك الخاصة بالكامل. يمكن تعطيل P2P في أي وقت من الإعدادات.

playback_section_buffer_network_desc: How much content to keep in memory and how to fetch streams.
playback_buffer_custom_sub: Override Media3\'s default buffering with the values below. When off, the player uses Media3\'s stock buffer durations and target size.
playback_buffer_warning: These settings affect buffering behavior. Incorrect values may cause playback issues.
playback_buffer_min_sub: Minimum amount of media to buffer. The player will try to ensure at least this much content is always buffered ahead of the current playback position.
playback_buffer_max_sub: Maximum amount of media to buffer. Must be at least the minimum buffer duration. Higher values use more memory but provide smoother playback on unstable connections.
playback_buffer_initial_sub: How much content must be buffered before playback starts. Lower values start faster but may cause initial stuttering on slow connections.
playback_buffer_after_rebuffer_sub: How much content to buffer after playback stalls due to buffering. Higher values reduce repeated buffering interruptions.
playback_buffer_back_sub: How much already-played content to keep in memory. Enables fast backward seeking without re-downloading. Set to 0 to disable and save memory.
playback_buffer_back_reserve: Reserves ~%1$dMB on top of Target Buffer. Raising Max Buffer Duration shrinks this without losing back-buffer time.
playback_buffer_managed_sub: Caps the buffer to a safe share of this device\'s memory. Turn off to set the Target Buffer Size yourself (advanced — large values can crash low-memory devices).
playback_buffer_target_sub: Maximum RAM used for ahead-buffering. The maximum is calculated from your device\'s available memory (Android\'s per-app heap limit), so higher-RAM devices unlock larger caps automatically.
playback_buffer_target_managed_hint: Managed by the device memory budget. Turn off Managed Memory Budget to set this.
playback_buffer_target_warning: Warning: above device safe limit (%1$d MB). App may crash during playback.
playback_buffer_allow_large_sub: Removes the device-memory cap on the Target Buffer Size slider, allowing values up to 2GB. May crash on devices with less than 2GB of RAM.
playback_cache_vod_sub: Persist downloaded bytes to disk for the current stream. Extends instant seek-back beyond the in-memory back buffer and survives brief network drops. Only applies to progressive streams (no HLS/DASH).
playback_cache_auto_size_sub: When on, the cache is sized from free disk space. Turn off to pick a size manually.
playback_cache_vod_size_sub: Maximum disk usage for progressive VOD cache (LRU-evicted).
playback_cache_info_auto: Auto mode targets about 10% of free space.
playback_cache_info_restart: New cache cap applies after app restart when changing between modes/sizes.
playback_net_custom_sub: Use multiple parallel connections to fetch progressive streams. When off, a single connection is used.
playback_net_parallel_sub: Use multiple connections in parallel for fetching streams. Activate when you experience buffering although your download speed is definitely more than sufficient.
playback_net_connection_count_sub: Number of parallel TCP connections. Higher values increase memory usage and throughput but with diminishing returns.
playback_net_chunk_size_sub: Size of each download chunk per connection. Larger chunks reduce overhead but use more memory.
